owner_path: workspace.owner_id -> auth.users.id; plan -> workspace; task -> plan; execution/completion -> task; review/version -> plan
database_access: RLS enabled with no browser table/RPC grants. Server-only service_role RPCs verify a hashed live application session on every request and derive owner from it. Service keys bypass RLS: RPC owner checks are required, not optional.

sessions.secret: 256-bit random cookie, never stored in plaintext in DB
sessions.hash: SHA-256 of random cookie; not a password hashing method
sessions.cookie: HttpOnly; Secure in production; SameSite=Strict; Path=/
sessions.revocation: Logout/password change revokes all application sessions for that user; expiry/revocation checked inside RPC under row lock.

passwords: Supabase Auth managed bcrypt with random salt; auth.users.encrypted_password. Application does not implement password hashing or export Auth data.

observation.metric: daily actual execution minutes; sum selected execution records; new default 실제 실행 시간; legacy 실제 공부 시간 preserved
observation.date: server today; start-date and creation-date of selected logs must match server Seoul date
observation.days: Exactly five different actual dates, one saved record per date, ascending order; no future/backdated day input
observation.day1: Observation start and first daily record must be on same Seoul date; selected logs start after observation creation
observation.change: One change after day2 saved, before day3 execution and save; exact day1/day2 IDs referenced
observation.missing: Do not impute zero; day remains incomplete
observation.duplicate: Reject duplicate session IDs and duplicate daily date; request IDs scoped to workspace
observation.outlier: Keep actual value; over 240 minutes requires confirmation note
observation.rounding: Integer minute sums; display averages rounded to two decimal places

deletion: Auth user deletion cascades workspace, diary records, observations, application sessions and request deduplication data. Plan-to-source-review FK uses SET NULL to resolve cycle.
export: All owned diary and observation data in one JSON file; exclude Auth password hashes, session hashes/cookies and private service keys.
